newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huludao Zinc expects huge rise in profit.
newsitem.headline: China's Huludao Zinc expects huge rise in profit.

text.p: China's Huludao Zinc Co, the world's biggest zinc smelter, expects profits to surge this year and plans to list a subsidiary, the Huludao Zinc Industry Co, on a domestic stock exchange, the China Daily said on Sunday.
The company expects to achieve 281 million yuan ($33.86 million) in pre-tax profits this year with a post-tax profit of more than 69 million, the China Daily Business Weekly said.
In January-April, the smelter earned 27 million yuan in profit, or an increase of more than 20 percent, it said.
Technical renovation in the last 10 years has lifted production capacity to 330,000 tonnes from 60,000 tonnes of zinc.

The company, set up in 1937, had struggled to cope with the transition from a planned to a market economy but was now able to produce 330,000 tonnes of zinc, 60,000 tonnes of crude copper, 80,000 tonnes of copper and 800,000 tonnes of sulphuric acid a year, the newspaper said.
